mapper.sql: select p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.engineering_project, p.project_category_id, p.client_unit, p.client_unit_nature, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.project_location, p.contract_id, p.data_source, p.status, p.project_nature, p.close_time, p.assign_date, p.duration_require, p.total_duration, p.extra_data::text as extra_data, p.del_flag, p.related_project_id, p.related_project_code_text, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from proj_project p
mapper.select:
select p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.engineering_project, p.project_category_id, p.client_unit, p.client_unit_nature, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.project_location, p.contract_id, p.data_source, p.status, p.project_nature, p.close_time, p.assign_date, p.duration_require, p.total_duration, p.extra_data::text as extra_data, p.del_flag, p.related_project_id, p.related_project_code_text, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.name as category_name, ct.contract_name, ct.contract_no, coalesce(rp.project_code, p.related_project_code_text) as related_project_code, coalesce(ln.leader_names, '') as leader_names, ct.contract_amount as contract_amount, coalesce(wo.internal_output, 0) as internal_output, coalesce(wo.external_output, 0) as external_output from proj_project p left join proj_category c on c.id = p.project_category_id left join proj_contract ct on ct.id = p.contract_id left join proj_project rp on rp.id = p.related_project_id left join lateral ( select string_agg(u.nick_name, ', ' order by l.id) as leader_names from proj_leader l inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.user_id where l.project_id = p.id and l.del_flag = '0' ) ln on true left join lateral ( select sum(coalesce(w.internal_output, 0)) as internal_output, sum(coalesce(w.external_output, 0)) as external_output from proj_workload w where w.project_id = p.id and w.del_flag = '0' ) wo on true where p.del_flag = '0'
AND (p.project_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.client_unit like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.engineering_project like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.contact_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_location like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.contact_name like concat('%', #{contactName}, '%')
AND p.contact_phone like concat('%', #{contactPhone}, '%')
AND p.project_location like concat('%', #{projectLocation}, '%')
AND EXISTS (select 1 from proj_leader l where l.project_id = p.id and l.user_id = #{leaderId} and l.del_flag = '0')
AND p.assign_date >= to_date(#{assignDateBegin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND p.assign_date <= to_date(#{assignDateEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND p.project_code like concat('%', #{projectCode}, '%')
AND p.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%')
AND p.engineering_project like concat('%', #{engineeringProject}, '%')
AND p.project_category_id = #{projectCategoryId}
AND p.project_category_id in
#{cid}
AND p.client_unit like concat('%', #{clientUnit}, '%')
AND p.contract_id = #{contractId}
AND p.contract_id IS NOT NULL
AND p.contract_id IS NULL
AND p.id in
#{oid}
AND 1 = 0
AND p.close_time >= to_date(#{closeDateBegin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND p.close_time < to_date(#{closeDateEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
AND >= to_date(#{newDateBegin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND < to_date(#{newDateEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
AND p.data_source = #{dataSource}
AND p.status = #{status}
AND p.project_nature = #{projectNature}
AND p.client_unit_nature = #{clientUnitNature}
AND p.status in
#{s}
AND p.create_time >= to_timestamp(#{params.beginTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND p.create_time <= to_timestamp(#{params.endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND EXISTS (select 1 from proj_workload w where w.project_id = p.id and w.del_flag = '0')
AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from proj_workload w where w.project_id = p.id and w.del_flag = '0')
AND EXISTS (select 1 from proj_payment pm where pm.project_id = p.id and pm.del_flag = '0' and pm.payment_type in ('advance', 'final'))
AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from proj_payment pm where pm.project_id = p.id and pm.del_flag = '0' and pm.payment_type in ('advance', 'final'))
AND EXISTS (select 1 from proj_payment pm where pm.project_id = p.id and pm.del_flag = '0' and (pm.invoice_date is not null or (pm.invoice_amount is not null and pm.invoice_amount > 0))) AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from proj_payment pm2 where pm2.project_id = p.id and pm2.del_flag = '0' and pm2.payment_type in ('advance', 'final') and pm2.amount is not null and pm2.amount > 0)
order by ct.contract_amount desc nulls last, p.id desc order by ct.contract_amount asc nulls last, p.id desc order by coalesce(wo.internal_output, 0) desc, p.id desc order by coalesce(wo.internal_output, 0) asc, p.id desc order by coalesce(wo.external_output, 0) desc, p.id desc order by coalesce(wo.external_output, 0) asc, p.id desc order by p.id desc

select p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.engineering_project, p.project_category_id, p.client_unit, p.client_unit_nature, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.project_location, p.contract_id, p.data_source, p.status, p.project_nature, p.close_time, p.assign_date, p.duration_require, p.total_duration, p.extra_data::text as extra_data, p.del_flag, p.related_project_id, p.related_project_code_text, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.name as category_name, ct.contract_name, ct.contract_no, coalesce(rp.project_code, p.related_project_code_text) as related_project_code, coalesce(ln.leader_names, '') as leader_names from proj_project p left join proj_category c on c.id = p.project_category_id left join proj_contract ct on ct.id = p.contract_id left join proj_project rp on rp.id = p.related_project_id left join lateral ( select string_agg(u.nick_name, ', ' order by l.id) as leader_names from proj_leader l inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.user_id where l.project_id = p.id and l.del_flag = '0' ) ln on true where p.id = #{id}
select project_code from proj_project where del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into proj_project( project_code, project_name, engineering_project, project_category_id, client_unit, client_unit_nature, contact_name, contact_phone, project_location, contract_id, data_source, status, project_nature, assign_date, close_time, duration_require, total_duration, extra_data, related_project_id, related_project_code_text, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{engineeringProject}, #{projectCategoryId}, #{clientUnit}, #{clientUnitNature}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{projectLocation}, #{contractId}, #{dataSource}, #{status}, #{projectNature}, #{assignDate}, #{closeTime}, #{durationRequire}, #{totalDuration}, #{extraData}::jsonb, #{relatedProjectId}, #{relatedProjectCodeText}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now() )

insert into proj_project( project_code, project_name, engineering_project, project_category_id, client_unit, project_location, data_source, status, project_nature, assign_date, close_time, create_by, create_time ) values
( #{item.projectCode}, #{item.projectName}, #{item.engineeringProject}, #{item.projectCategoryId}, #{item.clientUnit}, #{item.projectLocation}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.status}, coalesce(#{item.projectNature}, 'normal'), #{item.assignDate}, #{item.closeTime}, #{item.createBy}, now() )
mapper.delete: update proj_project set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id}

update proj_project set del_flag = '2' where id in
#{id}
mapper.update: update proj_project set status = 'closed', close_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update proj_project set total_duration = #{totalDuration}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update proj_project set close_time = case when close_time is null or close_time < #{closeTime} then #{closeTime} else close_time end, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select p.id as project_id, p.project_code as project_code, p.project_name as project_name, p.engineering_project, p.client_unit, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.project_location, p.status as status, c.name as category_name, cp.price as contract_price from proj_project p left join proj_category c on c.id = p.project_category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join proj_contract_price cp on cp.contract_id = p.contract_id and cp.category_id = p.project_category_id and cp.del_flag = '0' where p.contract_id = #{contractId} and p.del_flag = '0' order by p.create_time

choose.when: select distinct client_unit as val from proj_project where del_flag = '0' and client_unit is not null and client_unit != '' union select distinct client_unit as val from proj_contract where del_flag = '0' and client_unit is not null and client_unit != '' order by val
choose.otherwise: select distinct ${field} as val from proj_project where del_flag = '0' and ${field} is not null and ${field} != '' order by ${field}

mapper.select: select status, count(1) as cnt from proj_project where del_flag = '0' group by status order by status

select column_name as "columnName", coalesce(col_description(#{tableName}::regclass, ordinal_position), column_name) as "columnComment" from information_schema.columns where table_name = #{tableName} order by ordinal_position

select p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name from proj_project p where p.del_flag = '0' and ( p.engineering_project in ( select c2.name from proj_category c2 where c2.del_flag = '0' and c2.level = 2 and c2.name like '%定线%' and c2.parent_id = ( select c.parent_id from proj_category c where c.name = #{engineeringProject} and c.del_flag = '0' and c.level = 2 limit 1 ) ) or p.project_category_id in ( select c2.id from proj_category c2 where c2.del_flag = '0' and c2.level = 2 and c2.name like '%定线%' and c2.parent_id = ( select c.parent_id from proj_category c where c.name = #{engineeringProject} and c.del_flag = '0' and c.level = 2 limit 1 ) ) ) order by p.create_time desc
